description: Get the link to register a .xrp / .xrpl / .xrpfi / .rlusd domain on xrpdomains.xyz. Registration is completed in the browser — the website handles the order and the user signs in their wallet there (the MCP does NOT build or broadcast the payment). Use when the user says "register X.xrpfi" or "buy X.xrp". Pass refcode if a referral applies.

refcode.description: Optional referral code to embed in the registration link.

name: register_domain
